prompt: A clean, straight-on photo of a restaurant bill split worked out in pen on a paper NAPKIN on a cafe table, plain handwriting-style print on a white napkin. Three friends split ONE bill unequally by agreed shares of the food subtotal, then a group discount, a service charge and a tip are applied in order. Food subtotal: 186.40 pounds. Agreed shares of the subtotal: Amir 40%, Beth 35%, Cal 25%. On EACH person's share these are applied in this order: first take off a 10 percent group DISCOUNT, then add a 12.5 percent SERVICE charge, then add a 15 percent TIP. The napkin lists three bold lines, one per person, 'Amir pays:', 'Beth pays:', 'Cal pays:', each followed by the final amount that person owes, to two decimals. Work out each person's amount (share = percent of subtotal; then multiply by one-minus-the-discount, then by one-plus-the-service, then by one-plus-the-tip) and print the three amounts. Print only these numbers; make the three 'pays' amounts legible. No working, no formula on the napkin.
